query:
SELECT
            monitor_id,
            COUNT(*)                              AS "total!",
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'up') AS "ok_count!"
        FROM heartbeats
        -- Maintenance excluded from uptime% (matches current_slo_uptime_pct).
        WHERE monitor_id = ANY($1) AND ts >= $2 AND status <> 'maintenance'
        GROUP BY monitor_id
